changelog_text:
Stable release for **KSA 2026.11.10.5801 on Windows x64** with **StarMap 0.5.4** and the .NET 10 x64 Runtime.

- Updates life support, crew condition, habitat zones, EVA supplies, game rules, editor undo/redo, part variants, HDR and the 242 lines of the 5801 changelog.
- All nine language options were switched in a real 5801 session. Habitat zones, display settings and HUD text were checked. 467 headless checks passed.
- New translations in the seven additional languages used local models and await independent native-speaker review. Some long HUD labels still clip.

## Downloads

- **Standard** `KsaBabel-0.2.4.zip`. Place the `KsaBabel` folder in the selected profile's `mods` folder and enable it with StarMap 0.5.4.
- **Portable** `KsaBabel-0.2.4-5801-Portable.zip`. Includes StarMap and a separate launcher. Follow the bundled setup instructions.
- Choose one package and enable one localization mod per profile. Retain your profile and settings when upgrading. Separate SHA-256 files accompany the two ZIPs.

这是 5801 的正式 GitHub 发行版。七种扩展语种新增译文使用本地模型辅助，仍待独立母语审校。包内说明记录了开发验证阶段，正式发行状态以本页为准。较早游戏版本请选择对应的历史 Release。

listing.description:
![KSA Babel nine-language cover](ksa-image:cover)

Multilingual display-layer localization for **KSA 2026.11.10.5801 on Windows x64**.

**5801 update:** v0.2.4 updates life support, crew status, habitat zones, EVA supplies, game rules, editor undo/redo, part variants, HDR settings and the 242 changelog lines for build 5801. New translations in the seven additional languages used local models and await independent native-speaker review. All nine locale switches were verified in an isolated 5801 game session.

**Translation review (earlier scope):** The maintainer has personally confirmed only the Simplified Chinese translation. Japanese, Russian, German, French, Italian, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese were translated/reviewed by GPT for KSA using KSP aerospace terminology as reference; they have no independent native-speaker sign-off. Some initial Japanese translations came from the credited MIT-licensed KsaUiLanguages project. English mode displays KSA's original English text and retains the mod's added Language menu. The 11 dynamic templates support multilingual composition and original-English fallback; they are not 11 rewritten game texts.

**Chinese-focused alternative:** [KSA Chinese / KSA-CHINESE](https://github.com/kuxiaowo/KSA-CHINESE), ID `KsaChinese`, offers English / Simplified Chinese. Its current release is [v0.1.8](https://github.com/kuxiaowo/KSA-CHINESE/releases/tag/v0.1.8), standard ZIP `KsaChinese-0.1.8.zip`, for the inspected Windows x64 KSA 2026.11.10.5801 build and StarMap 0.5.4. It has its own [Borea listing](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index/blob/main/listings/KsaChinese.toml). Babel is a separate nine-language localization mod under `KsaBabel`; do not enable both in the same profile.

- Translates supported UI, part and substance captions, tooltips and selected version history.
- Includes a renamed Noto Sans SC font subset and a nine-language menu.
- Seven additional languages each cover 5,716 reviewed source records plus 11 dynamic templates; AI review is not native-speaker approval.
- Language preferences are saved per game profile, outside the mod files, so Borea instances remain independent.
- Preserves technical identifiers, part/model numbers, units, placeholders and player names.
- Refuses uninspected game/dependency hashes; untranslated text falls back to the original.

This is **partial localization**, not an official translation or a claim of complete coverage. Older version-history text, native library/error text, texture lettering and complete UI/visual coverage remain unfinished. Compatibility with other localization mods has not been established.

Requires .NET 10 x64 Runtime and StarMap 0.5.4. Extract the standard `KsaBabel-0.2.4.zip` into the selected profile's `mods` folder and enable `KsaBabel`. The plugin assembly is KsaBabel.dll. Launch through StarMap/Borea.

For Borea-managed migration, remove KsaChinese from the instance while retaining profile data; disabling it alone does not resolve the catalog conflict. For manual installation, disable KsaChinese before enabling Babel; Babel refuses activation while KsaChinese is enabled. When migrating from the old portable package, first back up its Profile and move the old `<game>/Content/KsaChinese` out of Content. Do not keep both Content/KsaBabel and profile mods/KsaBabel. The standard mod ZIP does not bundle a loader or launcher.

Settings use the current profile's KsaBabel/settings.json. On first startup, only if this new file does not exist, Babel imports a valid locale from the same profile's old KsaChinese/settings.json, without modifying the old file or overwriting existing new settings. No saves are automatically moved and no other profiles are searched. The portable archive is KsaBabel-0.2.4-5801-Portable.zip; its launcher is KsaBabel/KsaBabelLauncher.exe.

Code and translations: MIT, including portions derived from LiX-Works/KsaUiLanguages at b504774158cc03b582a0e75bfe94330cb841f11d. Font: Noto Sans SC subset, OFL-1.1. Original credits and license texts are included.
